summary.text: Eric Boothroyd is the Democratic candidate for Maine House of Representatives District 31 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Republican Andrew Torbett; there is no incumbent in the race.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a retired manufacturing production planner and environmental, health and safety administrator from Dover-Foxcroft.

paragraphs.text: Eric Boothroyd advanced from the Democratic primary for District 31 on June 9, 2026.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he has been a Northern Maine resident for over 45 years and is retired from the manufacturing sector, having worked at Fayscott Co. in Dexter and Formtek in Clinton as a production planner and EHS administrator.
He said he graduated with a BA from Olivet College and worked for three years after college as a professional musician and member of the Musicians' Union.
Boothroyd said he serves as treasurer of the Piscataquis Democrats, is a former delegate to the Democratic State Committee, and is an active member of the League of Women Voters of Maine.
He said he lives in Dover-Foxcroft with his wife, Carole, a retired educator who ran for the Maine Senate in 2016.
Boothroyd said in the survey that he wants to promote legislation addressing affordability, including energy, healthcare, groceries, housing and property taxes.

He also said he supports environmental protection by reducing fossil fuel consumption, promoting renewable energy and addressing PFAS pollution, and that he would advocate for some form of universal healthcare.
He listed endorsements from Maine Conservation Voters Action Fund, the Maine Gun Safety Coalition, Planned Parenthood Maine Action Fund PAC, the Maine AFL-CIO and the Wabanaki Alliance.
